description:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Moonmist without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Moonmist, transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Ultimecia, Omnipotent by paying {1}{U}, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent and causing it to re-enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
Whenever Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Ultimecia, Time Sorceress trigger, causing you to surveil 2.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
Repeat each turn.
